targets.notes: Validation suggestions for an unknown field or type run this pure-Python Damerau-Levenshtein loop once per candidate name. Each call lowercases the option, allocates a code-point list, and updates three matrix rows in Python. On the GitHub schema that scan is the bulk of the cost of suggesting fields for typos.

Every execution collects selected fields here before resolvers run. The loop isinstance-checks each selection, scans @skip and @include even for fields with no directives, and allocates a FieldDetails tuple per field. About half of the time of a wide selection set is in this function itself, and the calls it makes are decided here.

Lexicographic schema sorts and suggestion ordering build a key for every type and field name. The helper splits each name with a digit regex, then boxes every piece in a tuple via itertools.cycle. A direct scan of the name would avoid both the regex and the per-name tuple.

print_schema calls this for every description to decide whether to use a block string. The body walks the description one code point at a time in Python. On the GitHub schema that scan is the largest self-time cost inside schema printing.
